component.name: FFmpeg Workbench
component.summary: Video and audio toolkit powered by FFmpeg

description.p: A collection of focused tools for everyday video and audio work: trim and crossfade clips, convert and compress, burn or generate subtitles, make GIFs and WebMs, colour-correct, stabilise, remove silence, normalise loudness, download videos and much more - all running locally with FFmpeg.
Much more of the app can be translated; the Mystical theme's stars fall over the window on Linux too; switching theme repaints everything without a restart.
The Video Downloader is described in general terms: it saves videos and audio you have the right to download. Updated yt-dlp, whisper.cpp and FluidSynth.

Four new languages: Traditional Chinese, Czech, Greek and Hungarian. Downloads are now H.264 + AAC by default, so they play everywhere, and a video link pasted on the Start page opens the Video Downloader.
Fixes: on Windows, offline text-to-speech no longer gives up when the system voice takes more than half a second, and a screen recording that ignores Stop is stopped.

A new name: FFmpeg Workbench, in a new repository. New: a Contact Sheet tool, and a much bigger Slideshow Maker (GIFs, video clips, title cards, 61 transitions including fading squares and swirl, music fitted to the slideshow and changes on the beat). The Crossfader gets the same transitions; every time box works the same way; fixes.

Smoother and sturdier: pages never freeze while the app checks what FFmpeg can do, every program the app starts can be stopped and is stopped on exit, and several fixes - Special Effects renders, HDR to SDR with a quick Render, the settings backup, TTS playback on Linux.
Snapshot: save any frame as a full-size, high-quality PNG. The , and . keys step one frame in every tool that picks a moment. The Multi-Splitter timeline works, and fixes for previews and layouts.
Proper HiDPI support: on a scaled screen the whole interface grows with the text, and the app no longer closes at start at 150% scaling or more. Previews with a logo or photo work again.
Portable downloads for Windows and Linux: unpack anywhere and run, nothing to install.
The mouse wheel scrolls the right way on Linux, and scrolling a page no longer changes drop-downs under the pointer. The Linux packages include their own Python, so nothing else needs installing.
Every tool rebuilt and tested; a Start page; new HDR to SDR, Tracks & Remux, Compare & Quality and Metadata Cleaner tools; FSR, NIS and AI upscaling; automatic collage layouts; a command line.
